requirements.text: Publish one ordered immutable commit per table version with complete data references.
Validate optimistic conflicts and protocol/schema compatibility before commit.
Read consistent snapshots and compact metadata without deleting files needed by live readers.

problem.scope: Provide snapshot isolation and schema evolution over immutable data objects and an ordered transaction log. Compare backend-supported conditional commit creation with an external commit coordinator. S3 currently supports conditional writes; neither design assumes atomic directory rename or append.

provenance.note: Authored interview preparation. Technical references support mechanisms, not the claim that a company asked this question.

references.supports: Conditional creation and compare-and-swap object writes; backend-specific preconditions.
references.title: S3 conditional writes

references.supports: Versioned commit actions, checkpoints and reader/writer protocol compatibility.
references.title: Delta transaction protocol

acceptanceCases.given: Two writers read version 4 and both try to create version 5.
acceptanceCases.then: Only one version-5 commit exists; the overlapping loser conflicts rather than overwriting or silently appending.
acceptanceCases.when: Attempt atomic create-if-absent, then revalidate a loser whose predicate overlaps the winning write.

acceptanceCases.given: Two writers target the same version key after reading one snapshot.
acceptanceCases.then: Only one creates that immutable version; loser rereads and revalidates conflict predicates.

acceptanceCases.given: A reader pins version 12 while version 13 commits and checkpoint 10 is available.
acceptanceCases.then: Read version 12 consistently without mixing new metadata or requiring directory rename.

acceptanceCases.given: An old snapshot still references a data file while an uncommitted upload ages past grace.
acceptanceCases.then: Retain referenced files and collect only proven orphan objects; schema/protocol conflicts abort unsafe commits.
acceptanceCases.when: Run cleanup with the active-reader floor.
